text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the tea is ready.
Come, right this way.

It happened on the day I was invited
to a Mejiro family tea party to take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Gathering together like this
somehow reminds me of when we were young.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know. Hey, remember that?
Our 'growth-measuring tree'!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The one in the backyard?
Ah, yes! Lady Ardan marked the tree trunk
according to our heights, didn't she~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bright, when you were little,
you grew up pretty fast, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Dober took a while to grow, so she'd often get impatient, try to overreach...
and end up taking a tumble, remember?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's embarrassing...! But even back then, Ardan-san was always the one to comfort me.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: Waaah, it hurts...!

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll treat you right away.
There, see? It doesn't hurt... Once we're done,
shall we have some nice, sweet black tea?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san's tea...
Whenever I cried, you would always brew some for me.
It was slightly sweet and so comforting."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...Though,
looking back on it now, since it was for children,
perhaps I should have made it a little sweeter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I only ate bland food, so out of habit...
How is the seasoning now, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that is a relief.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... honestly.
Just because Trainer is here, none of you have to talk solely about me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Come, come, since we have this wonderful opportunity!
Oh yes, speaking of Ardan-san, back when I got lost in the mansion—

While conversation blossomed with fond memories,
everything was fine right up until I excused myself to the restroom, but...
I was supposed to return to my original room, but somehow I ended up in the kitchen.
choice_data_list: (M-My phone... I left that behind too!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
Where are you?

Relieved as I was, I suddenly recalled
the story I had just heard a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—When I got lost at the mansion,
you came looking for me, didn't you, Ardan-san?
You searched so hard, the entire time in the cold...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And then, Ardan-san was bedridden the next day.
I felt so awful about it!
I think I just bawled my eyes out...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Back then, Ryan-oneesama...
If I recall, you clung to Lady Ardan's bed
and got scolded by the servants, didn't you~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Yeah,
I definitely didn't want to let go back then, did I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, thank goodness!
I've found you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I made you look all over for me.
Sorry, made you look for me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, believe it or not, hide-and-seek was
always my best game in the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: After all, I spent my childhood shut away inside the mansion... Before I knew it, its vast and intricate layout was completely etched into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Which is why... no matter when,
even if you get lost countless times, Trainer,
I am certain I will always find you.
choice_data_list: I'm happy, but I won't keep hesitating like that over and over

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a pity. If you had lost your way and burst into tears,
I was planning to brew you
a cup of delightfully sweet black tea, too♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? It sounds quite lively outside.
choice_data_list: Looks like everyone went out into the yard.
Looks like everyone went outside to the yard, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they're looking for the "Height Measuring Tree."
When they do that, they seem just like they were when they were little, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that those kids won't get lost anymore...
makes me feel kind of lonely, but also happy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that those kids
won't get lost anymore...
makes me feel kind of lonely, but also happy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"My, my... fufufu...♪
Just a moment ago, I spotted a rather adorable
lost child as well, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it...
Trainer, weren't you taking a nap
in the trainer's office the other day?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I remember it being... a very heartwarming sight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Heeey! Ardan-san, everyone~!!
I found the tree~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ! ...Fufu, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Those girls have always tended to push themselves too hard.
For their dreams, for their pride... I understand that feeling all too well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because I understand that I want to help.
As an elder who is merely a little further along the path,
I hope you can rely on me at least somewhat...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Heeey! Ardan-san, everyone~!!
I found the tree~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ryan, shouting at the
top of her lungs like that... Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's get going too.
I'm sure everyone is waiting for us.

It was a truly special day, catching a glimpse
of a side to Mejiro Ardan I had never seen before...!
